title: My space incremental demo drops Monday. Would love feedback on the build menu before it goes out
author: Civil-Ad-7646
selftext:
Hey, I've been working solo on Beyond the Cradle, an incremental game where you start on one planet and spread across the whole solar system. The demo is out on Steam this Monday, a wishlist would help a lot: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4464270/Beyond\_the\_Cradle/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4464270/Beyond_the_Cradle/)

I'd love some feedback before launch. Is the build menu clear? Can you tell what each building does from the card art? Anything you'd change?

Also, the planet uses a hex board right now, but a few people told me a square grid might be better. Which one would you rather play on?
